details.label: Object Notes
details.text:
Constellation: Ursa Major
Location: RA: 14h 05m 0.0s Dec: +53d 40' 00" Epoch 2000
Size: 5.0 x 4.5 arc-minutes
Magnitude: 10.8
Type: Spiral Galaxy
AKA: UGC 9013

details.label: Camera
details.text:
SBIG STL-11000 CCD camera
(See product review in July, 2004 issue of Sky & Telescope magazine.)
with Astrodon Tru-Balance color filters.

details.label: Exposure
details.text:
15 x 5 minutes Luminance unbinned
4 x 5 minutes each R/G/B, all unbinned

details.label: Guiding
details.text:
Off-Axis with STV Autoguider
(Santa Barbara Instrument Group)
(See product review in May, 2003 issue of Astronomy magazine.)
See Photo/Guiding Equipment.

details.label: Post Processing
details.text: CCDSoft, CCDSharp, MaxIM DL, Photoshop CS
